name: Cetus Yield Agent
description: Autonomous concentrated-liquidity agent on Cetus Protocol (Sui). Phase 1 monitors pool prices read-only; Phase 2+ opens positions, earns trading fees, and auto-repositions when the price drifts out of range.
author: holonym-foundation

envVars.description: Cetus pool object ID (e.g. SUI/USDC: 0xb8d7d9e66a60c239e7a60110efcf8de6c705580ed924d0dde141f4a0e2c90105)
`monitor` (read-only, no funds at risk - Phase 1) or `active` (opens + rebalances real positions - Phase 2+)
Half-width of the position's tick range around the current tick
Drift in ticks from position centre before triggering a rebalance
Milliseconds between pool checks (default 5 minutes per recipe)
Sui network: `mainnet` or `testnet`
Sui gRPC endpoint (defaults to https://fullnode.<NETWORK>.sui.io:443)
Hard cap on the estimated total USD value of both SUI and USDC deposited when opening or reopening. Active mode refuses to start without a positive value.
If `true`, simulate every tx via Sui gRPC instead of submitting via waap-cli. Logs effects + gas so operators can verify a planned action before going live.
Path to the rebalance intent file used for crash-recovery reconciliation (default: `<projectName>.intent.json` in cwd)
Optional path for a JSON-line log file (default: `<projectName>.log` in cwd)
Number of recent cycles used to estimate tick volatility
Minimum adaptive position half-width in ticks
Maximum adaptive position half-width in ticks
Multiplier applied to observed tick volatility when selecting the range
Minimum tick samples required before adaptive ranges activate
Fraction of available USDC considered for an initial position, still bounded by the USD cap
Fraction of available USDC considered when reopening, still bounded by the USD cap
Alias for the Sui gRPC endpoint; SUI_RPC takes precedence
Override the default Sui USDC coin type
Estimated SUI gas per transaction used for local cumulative telemetry
Optional Sui wallet address override for non-interactive WaaP hosts
Run the cross-protocol yield scan every N agent cycles
Delay before active mode may open a position after startup
Write a PID file for external supervisor liveness checks
Override the supervisor PID-file path
Optional Matrix homeserver for operational alerts
Optional Matrix access token; keep it only in the local .env or a secret manager
Optional Matrix room ID for error and rebalance alerts
